changelog: Updated docs: Emphasize testing reproducibility, perfect 50/50 coin flip, hash verification. Clear warnings about non-cryptographic use. Agent-focused examples for debugging flaky tests.
summary: Deterministic entropy streams for reproducible testing and procedural generation. Perfect 50/50 statistical distribution with hash verification. Not cryptographically secure - use for testing, worldgen, and scenarios where reproducibility matters more than unpredictability.
